direction.camera: Guide attention with high key; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: isolate the subject inside a bright seamless studio; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.
direction.editing: Open with white infinity; alternate proof and breathing room, then resolve with confident space.
direction.lighting: large shadowless softboxes; preserve subject contour and separate it from the supporting field.
direction.materials: white enamel and translucent glass; actual material appearance comes from approved imagery or a real 3D asset.
direction.sound: Create a restrained rhythm around soft edge; place licensed accents on intentional cuts and keep speech clear.
direction.typography: Use high key,white infinity,clean shadow,product clarity,soft edge,confident space as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
